categories.main_business_segments: Kohnan Shoji operates primarily in the home improvement retail sector, focusing on home centers, building materials wholesale, and related retail businesses. The group includes subsidiaries engaged in home center operations in Japan and overseas (Vietnam, Cambodia), building materials wholesale, and retail of household goods and food. The company also provides logistics, real estate leasing, and peripheral distribution services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operational methods center on large-scale retailing, efficient store operations, and supply chain management. It emphasizes private brand (PB) product development, inventory control, and logistics optimization. The group utilizes standard Japanese retail and inventory management systems, with a focus on operational efficiency, store network expansion, and digital transformation initiatives such as e-commerce integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kohnan Shoji serves both individual consumers (DIY/home improvement, household goods, gardening, pet supplies, food) and professional customers (builders, contractors) through its PRO store format and building materials wholesale. Its main markets are general consumers seeking home and lifestyle products, as well as small to medium-sized construction professionals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary operations are in Japan, with a strong base in the Kansai region and expanding presence in Kanto and other areas. It also operates stores in Vietnam and Cambodia through subsidiaries. Over 90% of sales and assets are concentrated in Japan, with a growing but still minor international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kohnan Shoji is positioned downstream in the supply chain as a retailer and wholesaler, directly serving end consumers and professional customers. It also engages in some midstream activities through its building materials wholesale subsidiary and logistics operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include aggressive store expansion (especially PRO format), strengthening private brand product development, integrating e-commerce with physical stores, enhancing customer loyalty through digital membership, and logistics efficiency. The company is also focused on ESG initiatives, sustainability, and human capital development. There is no significant mention of traditional R&D; innovation is mainly in business model, digitalization, and operational improvement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of goods at retail stores and online, as well as wholesale of building materials. Additional income comes from real estate leasing and peripheral services. The business is transaction-based, with some recurring revenue from memberships and loyalty programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese home center chains such as Cainz, Komeri, and DCM Holdings, as well as discount retailers and specialty stores. Kohnan Shoji is positioned as a leading home and lifestyle retailer in Japan, with a particular strength in the PRO (professional) segment and a dominant presence in the Kansai region.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending February 2025, consolidated revenue was 501.4 billion yen, with operating profit of 25.0 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 14.2 billion yen. The company operates over 630 stores and employs nearly 5,000 full-time staff (plus over 11,000 part-time/temporary). Growth has been steady, with a 6.1% year-on-year increase in revenue and ongoing store network expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kohnan Shoji differentiates itself through a broad product assortment, competitive pricing, and a strong focus on private brand (PB) products. Its PRO format targets professional customers, and the company emphasizes convenience through integrated e-commerce, store network density, and customer loyalty programs. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability, community contribution, and stable supply through efficient logistics.
